result_text:
I fixed the four broken default scoping conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`. The full codeanalyzer suite passes (333 tests, 0 failures, 3 skipped), and I did not commit.

Changes, all in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **HTML generated pages:** the path pattern for the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules was `(html|html|xhtml)`. It is now `(htm|html|xhtml)`.
- **.NET assembly docs:** the path pattern `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches. The `<doc>` content check is unchanged.
- **JavaScript `// Generated by …`:** the path pattern `.*/[.]js` is now `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** the build-and-deployment pattern `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It reads the private default lists by reflection and checks that the `.htm`, `<doc>` XML, `app.js` and `build-gradle.js` cases match. It also checks that the existing `.html`, `.xhtml` and `build.gradle` cases still match, and that a hand-written `.htm`, `settings.xml` and `src/app.js` stay out.
